XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='ResLabMisys:ORU_R01' targetDocType='ResLabMisys:ORU_R01' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Convert Misys record to PowerPath</annotation> <trace value='"In DTL"' /> <assign value='source' property='target' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.{OBX()}' key='k1' > <if condition='..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k1):ObservationIdentifier.identifier}) = "COMPON"' > <true> <if condition='..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k1):ObservationValue}) = "RHIGX"' > <true> <trace value='"In first if true"' /> <foreach property='source.{OBX()}' key='k2' > <if condition='k2 = 1' > <annotation>Set k2 to start with k1 value</annotation> <true> <assign value='k1 + 1' property='k2' action='set' /> </true> </if> <trace value='"Start with " _ k2 _ " " _ ..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k2):ObservationIdentifier.identifier}) _", " _ ..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k2):ObservationValue}) ' /> <if condition='..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k2):ObservationIdentifier.identifier}) = "STATUS"' > <true> <if condition='..ToUpper(source.{OBX(k2):ObservationValue}) = "ISSU"' > <true> <trace value='"In Second if true"' /> <if condition='source.{OBX(k2):Observationresultstatus} = "P"' > <true> <if condition='source.{OBR:ResultStatus} = "P"' > <true> <trace value='"Set values"' /> <assign value='"F"' property='target.{OBX(k2):Observationresultstatus}' action='set' /> <assign value='"F"' property='target.{OBR:ResultStatus}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </true> </if> </true> </if> </true> </if> </foreach> </true> </if> </true> </if> </foreach> </transform>
